subject: Request to convert contract role to FTE + payband exception proposal
messages:
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Alyssa Grant <alyssa@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to convert contractor to FTE + payband exception proposal

Team —

Quick summary: the Runtime team is asking to convert our current contractor slot (Contrax ID: C-1729, currently filled by Daniel Cho via Contrax) into a full-time Senior Runtime SWE (target start Q3). The contractor has been onsite for 10 months and is running point on kernel selection for quantized paths — the ramp is high and losing them would set back the low-latency effort by 6–8 weeks.

Why this is unusual: Daniel's market expectation is noticeably above our current L5 payband floor due to prior specialized infra work; hiring manager (Will) is recommending a payband exception to place at L5+ (base ~15% above band floor) + signing bonus, in order to convert rather than re-run search.

Attached: HC request packet and current comp bands snapshot.
Asks: 
- Approval to convert contractor slot to FTE (headcount change) — action by Finance / People ops
- Payband exception approval (L5 with above-floor placement) or guidance for an alternative (bonus structure, deferred review)
- Route to finance for budget delta if approved

I included Alyssa from Contrax to confirm candidate availability and run-down of fees. If we can agree by EOD Tuesday, hiring manager will extend an offer the same week.

Thanks — Mina
Mina Haddad
Director, Platform Engineering (Runtime)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: hc_request_runtime_conversion_20280618.pdf, comp_bands_snapshot_q2_2028.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 09:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to convert contractor to FTE + payband exception proposal

Mina —

Thanks for the write-up. Two quick clarifying Qs:
1) What does the FY28 budget look like for Platform headcount vs. committed spend? Is this replacing a vacated headcount or growing the slate?
2) If we do an above-band base, what's the ongoing comp delta (annualized) and which bucket do we charge for the first year?

If this is a true conversion (no net-new slot) I have more flexibility; if we're expanding the headcount plan we need exec approval in the next finance review window. Please include the hiring manager's recommended comp table in the thread (numbers).

-Karthik
VP, Platform Finance

To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>, Alyssa Grant <alyssa@talentbridge.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to convert contractor to FTE + payband exception proposal

Adding context from Will (hiring manager):
- This is effectively a conversion (we had originally budgeted a headcount for H2 but filled it with a contractor due to timing). Converting keeps us on-plan for H2 deliverables and avoids a new search.
- Recommended placement: L5 (Senior) with base at 15% above L5 floor, target total comp aligned to 60th percentile for infra/runtime in SF. Proposed structure: base + 10% sign-on + standard equity band for L5.
- Impact if we lose: 6–8 week delay on kernel rollout, additional contractor spend ~ $120k if we re-contract interim.

I've attached a short offer worksheet (numbers pulled into the HC packet). If finance needs, we can charge the delta to Platform contingency for Q3 (we've got ~2 slots of wiggle room there).

Marissa
Sr. Dir, Talent & Recruiting (Platform)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 18 Jun 2028 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to convert contractor to FTE + payband exception proposal

Appreciate the packet. A couple of operational notes from People ops: 
- We prefer to avoid permanent above-band placement if we can meet candidate expectations via a combination of sign-on + 6-month performance review with a market adjustment clause. That keeps band integrity intact.
- If the hiring manager insists on above-band base, we need an exec-level payband exception (submit via the Pay Governance form) and a proposed calibration note for comp committee. This typically adds ~2 weeks to timeline.
- For budget routing: we can charge the one-time delta to Platform contingency for Q3 and submit the HC form; I will own the workflow.

My recommendation: extend an offer with a market-competitive base within band (top of band if possible), a 10% sign-on, and a guaranteed 6-month calibrated review with a defined target uplift if performance and impact metrics are met. This removes the need for formal exception and keeps the candidate engaged.

If the hiring manager prefers the above-band base as written, put the justification in the payband exception form and I'll expedite.

— Soojin
Head of People Ops

From: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@talentbridge.com>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Daniel Cho <daniel.cho@contrax.io>
Date: Tue, 19 Jun 2028 08:17:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to convert contractor to FTE + payband exception proposal

Hi all — quick operational note from the vendor side: Daniel is interested in converting to FTE with a preference for base + equity; he has a competing timeline (two other active processes) and would like an answer within 7 business days. He is flexible on sign-on vs. base but prefers base if the company can meet a small uplift from the internal L5 target.

Fee note: if you convert directly (no new vendor placement), standard conversion fee applies — details in the candidate_expectations_allyssa_thread.txt attached. If Redwood extends FTE through direct hire and waives vendor fee, Alyssa asks for 48hr notice so Contrax can close the loop.

— Alyssa

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Alyssa Grant <alyssa@talentbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 16:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request to convert contractor to FTE + payband exception proposal — consolidated ask

Thanks all — consolidation below and next steps: 
- Proposal we are asking for approval on: convert contractor slot to FTE (no net-new headcount change) and extend offer at L5 with base at +12% above L5 floor + 10% sign-on + standard L5 equity. This is a compromise between manager ask and People ops guidance.
- Budget impact (annualized delta): ~$48k; we request Platform contingency to absorb for Q3 and Finance to reclass the line item.
- Governance: If People ops agrees to the compromise, no formal payband exception is required; Soojin to confirm and I will route to Finance. If Finance pushes back, we will fill the formal payband exception and seek comp committee by EOW.

Requested approvals: 
1) Karthik — approve charging delta to Platform contingency for Q3 (approve/need more info)
2) Marissa — confirm recruiting will proceed with offer language above (yes/no)
3) Soojin — confirm whether the proposed compromise avoids payband exception and if you can own routing to Finance

If we get sign-off today, Marissa will brief Will and extend a verbal offer; Alyssa — Daniel is expecting next-week availability for start conversations.

Thanks — Mina
